properties.description: 'Creates an incident for Data Security Violation events for DSPM license users.'
properties.name: Create Incident for Data Security Violation events for DSPM license users
properties.query:
Rubrik_Violation_Data_CL
| where class_s == "SecurityViolation" and custom_details_eventName_s in ("CriticalSeverityDataViolationDetected",
"CriticalSeverityDataViolationReOpen",
"HighSeverityDataViolationDetected",
"HighSeverityDataViolationReOpen",
"LowOrMediumSeverityDataViolationDetected",
"LowOrMediumSeverityDataViolationReOpen")
| extend NewSeverity = case(severity_s=="info", "Low",
                            severity_s=="warning", "Medium",
                            severity_s=="critical", "High",
                            "Informational"),
         ObjectId = iff(isnotempty(custom_details_objectId_s), custom_details_objectId_s, tostring(custom_details_objectId_g)),
         ViolationId = iff(isnotempty(custom_details_seriesId_s), custom_details_seriesId_s, tostring(custom_details_seriesId_g))

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: {{class_s}} event occurred for object {{custom_details_objectName_s}} with type {{custom_details_objectType_s}}
